body.name: One-shot adaptive occupancy handle
body.construction: Apply \(H_{\mathrm{adapt}}\): release one correlated multiscale array of occupancy-weighted projection scores and use only post-processing to perform Lepski comparisons over \(\Theta_{\mathrm{sm}}\), while retaining the ordered target-shell aggregation of \(H_{\mathrm{occ}}\).
